pages.text: This module includes miscellaneous features that do not belong to any other module.

pages.title: Ancient Tomes
pages.text: Allow you to increase enchantment levels beyond normal limits.

pages.title: Animal Poisoning
pages.text: Do not feed animals spider eyes.

pages.title: Colored Runes
pages.text: Allow you to change the enchantment glint color on tools.

pages.title: Endermites into Shulkers
pages.text: Endermites can burrow and transform into shulkers.

pages.title: Extra Arrows
pages.text: Explosive arrows detonate upon impact.

pages.title: Extra Potions
pages.text: New potion varieties with distinct effects.

pages.title: Horse Whistle
pages.text: Calls your horse within 64 blocks. It will come if it finds a path.

pages.title: Rotation Lock
pages.text: Allows you to lock block orientation while building.

pages.title: Monster Notes
pages.text: Note blocks that play monster sounds when heads are placed.

pages.title: Note Blocks
pages.text: Dedicated user interface for configuring note blocks.

pages.title: Pickarang
pages.text: A pickaxe that acts as a boomerang.

pages.title: Placeable Dusts
pages.text: Glowstone and gunpowder can be placed on the ground.

pages.title: Reacharound Placing
pages.text: Allows placing blocks around corners while standing still.

pages.title: Snow Golem Heads
pages.text: A named pumpkin snow golem killed by a witch drops player heads.

pages.title: Throw Dragon's Breath
pages.text: Dragon's breath can be thrown at targets.

pages.title: Matrix Enchanting
pages.text: Matrix enchanting is a complete overhaul of the enchanting system. Enchantment pieces are generated using lapis and experience, and then arranged on a grid to enchant items.

pages.title: Matrix Enchanting
pages.text: Precise control over enchantments applied to items.

pages.title: Totem of Holding
pages.text: A Totem of Holding appears where you die and stores your items. If you die again before collecting it, the totem shatters and drops everything.

pages.title: Totem of Holding
pages.text: Item preservation after death.

pages.title: Tiny Potato
pages.text: A decorative potato. You can name it, and it will speak.
